content.text: Capa lungkaang ni teh na pa e cangkhainae hah alawkpui lah a ta,
hatei kadudamnaw ni teh cangkhainae hah ngai awh hoeh.
Tami ni amae pahnipaw hah kahawicalah a ca han,
hatei yuemkamcu hoeh e tami teh rektapnae hoi a kâkawk han.
A pahni ka ring e ni teh a hringnae hah a ring toe,
hatei ka kaw lah a kâko ka ang e teh rawknae koe a pha han.
Tami pangaknaw ni teh a ngai poung awh ei banghai tawn awh hoeh,
hatei tami kahratbat e teh tawnta sak lah ao han.
Tamikalan ni teh laithoe dei e a hmuhma,
hatei tamikathout teh panuet ka tho e hoi
kayanae kaphawtkung doeh.
Toun han kaawm hoeh e lamthung ni lannae a ring,
hatei thoenae ni tamikayon a tâkhawng.
Tami ka tawnta lah a kâpouk ei banghai ka tawn hoeh e tami ao,
hatei kamathoe poung lah a kâpouk ei ka tawnta poung e ao.
Tami ka tawnta e ni kâratang nahane hnopai a tawn,
hatei mathoe ni yuenae kâhmo boihoeh.
Tamikalannaw e angnae teh kahawi poung e angnae doeh,
hatei tamikathoutnaw e hmaiim teh a due han.
Kâoupnae dawk doeh kâyuenae a tâco,
hatei pouknae kahawi poe e tarawinae teh lungangnae doeh.
Kamsoumhoehe lah hnopai la e teh tang a kahma han,
hatei panki laihoi hmu e hnopai teh a pung han.
Ring e hno tang hmu hoeh e ni lung a pataw sak,
hatei ngaikuepnae teh hringnae thingkung doeh.
Lawk banglahai ka noutna hoeh e teh rawk sak lah ao han,
hatei kâpoelawk e ka bari e teh tawkphu poe lah ao han.
Tami lungkaangnaw e kâpoelawk e teh
hringnae tuiphuek lah ao teh,
duenae karap rounnae lamthung lahai ao.
Thaipanueknae ni minhmai kahawi a poe,
hatei yuemkamcu hoeh naw e lamthung teh a ru poung.
Kho kapoukthai e pueng ni panuenae hoi a kâroe awh,
hatei tamipathu ni teh a pathunae a kamnue sak.
Patoune kathout teh runae dawk a rawp,
hatei yuemkamcu e laicei ni teh damnae a thokhai.
Tounnae banglahai ka ngaihoeh e tami koe
voutnae hoi yeiraiponae a pha han,
hatei tounnae alawkpui lah ka tat e teh bari lah ao han.
Ngaikuepnae teh a radip, hatei payonnae rounnae
hateh tamikathoutnaw ni a hmuhma awh.
Tamilungkaangnaw hoi kamyawng e teh a lung a ang han,
hatei, tamikathoutnaw hoi kamyawng e teh a rawk han.
Tamikayon teh thoenae ni a pâlei,
hatei tamikalan teh hawinae a pang han.
Tamikahawi ni teh a ca catounnaw hanelah râw a parâw pouh,
hatei tamikayonnaw e hnopai teh
tamikalannaw hanelah pâkhueng lah ouk ao.
Tamimathoe ni laikawk thawnnae lahoi rawca moi ao,
hatei thoenae dawk doeh rawknae koe ouk pha awh.
Bongpai ka hno ngai hoeh e teh a capa ka hmuhma e lah ao,
hatei a capa lung ka pataw e ni teh a nawca hoi ouk a yue toe.
Tamikalan teh a von a paha,
hatei tamikathout teh a vonhlam han.
